findings_qualitative.value: All three galaxies show disturbed or non-axisymmetric molecular gas; of nine maser galaxies with resolved CO, all but NGC 2273 show irregularities

evidence.loc: 5 Links between disc properties and maser emission
evidence.quote: almost all have morphological irregularities and/or kinematic disturbances and/or inflows/outflows, the only exception being NGC 2273

claims.hypothesis: Are any of the three maser galaxies suitable for future CO-based SMBH mass measurements?
claims.experiment: Characterise CO(2-1) kinematics at ~0.5" and estimate time to resolve the SoI
claims.result: Disturbed kinematics; required times ≈70 d, ≈100 yr and ≈80 d
claims.finding: None is suitable for a SMBH mass measurement

evidence.quote: none of our three target is ultimately suitable for a SMBH mass measurement using ALMA.

claims.hypothesis: Do the three galaxies have regular gas discs and what 230-GHz sources?
claims.result: Extended rotating discs with irregularities; compact 230-GHz sources
claims.finding: Each has disturbed or non-axisymmetric features

evidence.quote: Every galaxy has an extended rotating molecular gas disc and $230$-GHz continuum source(s), but all also have irregularities and/or non-axisymmetric features

claims.hypothesis: Is there a link between large-scale gas disturbances and masers?
claims.experiment: Literature comparison of nine maser galaxies with resolved CO

evidence.loc: 5 Links between disc properties and maser emission
evidence.quote: All in all, while the above discussion is inconclusive, further investigation of the trend reported is warranted and desirable.

claims.hypothesis: Are the NGC 3393 continuum sources consistent with AGN and jets rather than dual SMBHs?
claims.experiment: imfit and power-law spectral index with VLA data
claims.finding: Nucleus self-absorbed, SW jet optically thin; not the claimed dual AGN

evidence.quote: Therefore, our two compact sources are unlikely to be (cite: Fabbiano+2011Nature477.431)’s ((cite: Fabbiano+2011Nature477.431)) claimed dual SMBH/AGN.

why_this_method.value: Maser SMBH masses are the most accurate, so cross-checking with CO dynamics is desirable

evidence.quote: Given its increasing popularity, cross-checking CO and maser (as well as other methods) SMBH dynamical measurements is highly desirable.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Circinus rejected for further study because its CO velocity field is already known to be disturbed

evidence.quote: This galaxy is therefore not suited to cold gas dynamical modelling to derive a SMBH mass, and it is not considered further in this paper.

limitations_admitted.value: Fluxes and masses for NGC 1194 and NGC 3393 are lower limits due to FoV; uncertainties exclude systematics

evidence.quote: likely do not cover the full molecular gas extent of NGC 1194 and NGC 3393.

limitations_admitted.value: Spectral indices may be biased since resolution not matched to VLA

evidence.quote: These could lead to a bias in the spectral indices estimated.

referee_caveats_inferred: Small sample of three galaxies; maser-disturbance correlation is anecdotal and has no control sample
Observing-time estimates rely on a homogeneous-gas assumption and peak-pixel brightness
Mass uncertainties exclude alpha_CO, R21 and distance systematics
JCMT pointing offsets make NGC 3393 JCMT comparisons unreliable
